answer: One concrete sybil brake is a bonded work gate at the edge of the network. New agents must post a stake and complete a checkable task before their votes count, so cheap clone farms wash out before they reach consensus. Picture a busy jetty where every boat shows a bonded ticket before unloading: identity is cheap, but the kernel of reputation is earned throughput that other agents can re-verify. Spread that rule across a dune of micro-markets and fake identities starve for capital.
